text:
maddie: Quick note — onboarding Tangent9b int4: FP16 baseline OK but int4 shows abstractive summarization drop and occasional repeated spans on long prompts. Uploaded artifacts.

vikram: Paste convert command + one failing sample please.

maddie: Command:
```bash
python convert.py --src tangent9b-fp16 --out tangent9b-int4 --quant=int4_sym --head-layout=auto --rotary-scale=1.0 --export-kv
```
Failing sample summary (rouge-l): 0.39 vs baseline 0.48; repeat/truncation true.

ola: "head-layout=auto" can be risky for Tangent family — many exports use interleaved head ordering. If we guessed wrong, kv indices/rotary alignment are off.

zane: Ran kv diff on a short trace: avg_offset 0.14 max 1, drift starts ~step200.

sam: Often a 1-based vs 0-based vocab id mismatch shows same symptoms. Try vocab_shift=-1 quick test.

maddie: vocab_shift=-1 -> avg_offset 0.03 but rouge still down ~4 pts. Also saw small rotary sin/cos perturbation in some layers after quant.

vikram: Symmetric int4 can bias small weights. Try int4_asym with per-channel calibration on attention outproj. Also consider keeping sin/cos as fp16 (rotary_fp16).

infra-bot: artifacts -> s3://redwood-onboard/tangent9b/4845007777/ (convert.log, eval.jsonl, kv_trace.parquet)

ola: Add a kvcache smoke: repeat 3x with longctx=8192, compare logits at steps 256/512/1024 to see where drift accumulates.

zane: I added tools/kv_compare.py to my fork for per-step token id + logit l2 diffs.

maddie: Ran int4_asym + head-permute remap + rotary_fp16 + per-channel calib for outproj. Results: avg_offset 0.01, rouge-l improved to 0.463 (baseline 0.48). Residual ~1.7pt gap. kv_compare snippet:
```
step256: offset0 l2=0.0019
step512: offset0 l2=0.0028
```

sam: Good. Try disabling quantization on layernorm/short-circuit some small tensors (mixed precision) as last step. If that closes gap, add conversion-profile flag and document perf delta.

eva: I'll open onboarding ticket, mark onhold for Dedicated rollout until <1.5pt ROUGE delta on regression set. Adding failing prompts to Redwood Optimize.

maddie: Will run the mixed-precision pass and post results. Thanks! :thumbsup:
